svg.aria-label: 19 in bise desktop: the plugins place lists your plugin patch-notes next to bise's own skills and your skill folders; its page shows its skill and three lines to try; one click puts 'write the patch notes for 1.4' in bise's composer; you send it, and bise uses your skill and writes the page.
